name: Dockside 1953
notes: Restaurant's own domain (dockside1953.com, which mirrors bahiahotel.com/dockside-1953 identically) carries only descriptive text and hours, no priced menu or menu link/PDF anywhere on the site. The SinglePlatform listing embeds a full, well-structured schema.org hasOfferCatalog JSON-LD block (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Libations, Kids, Dessert, Weekend Brunch, and rotating Weekly Specials sections) which was parsed directly -- 144 priced items. OpenTable's page (also linked from search results as carrying 'View full menu') could not be reached to cross-validate: plain curl timed out/hung on every attempt (connection-level, not a 4xx) and a live browser fetch returned only OpenTable's bot-protection interstitial ('Powered and protected by ... Privacy'), never the real page. In lieu of that cross-check, item names were spot-verified against independent Yelp/review mentions (Poke Bowl, Classic Eggs Benedict, New England Clam Chowder, Artisan Bread Service, Jumbo Lump Crab Cakes, Avocado Toast & Egg, Club Sandwich) -- all present on the SinglePlatform listing with matching names, unlike the Marina Kitchen case where SinglePlatform prices were actively contradicted by a reachable OpenTable page. No such contradiction was found here, only an inability to reach the second source, so this is filed as found/medium rather than blocked.
